description.ja: 新作テレビアニメ『魔神創造伝ワタル』制作決定！主人公「星部ワタル」とともに冒険する「御富良院(おふらいん)」の魔神「風神丸」！
description.en: Production of the new TV anime “Mashin Souzouden Wataru” has been decided! Fujinmaru, the demon god of Ofurain, goes on an adventure with the main character, Wataru Hoshibe!

description.ja: • 部位ごとにパーツを分けられるシリーズ共通フレームを採用。他の魔神と組み合わせて遊ぼう！
description.en: • Adopts a common frame across the series that allows parts to be separated by area. Let's play in combination with other genies!

description.ja: • パチパチと手で外せるタッチゲート仕様。接着剤無しで組み立てられる！
description.en: • Touch gate design that can be removed by hand. Can be assembled without adhesive!

description.ja: • 刀は鞘へ収納が可能。鞘は背面に取り付けができる。
description.en: • The sword can be stored in the scabbard. The scabbard can be attached to the back.

description.ja: • 頭部などはメタリックなゴールド成形色で再現。
description.en: • The head and other parts are reproduced in metallic gold molding color.
